verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served at docs.stagehand.dev (HTTP 200) that indexes markdown versions of the doc pages, and the docs ship an AI-rules page of configs and copy-paste snippets so coding assistants write correct Stagehand v4 code. Pages are also served as .md, as the integration and best-practices URLs show. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs, evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt)
